The patient was diagnosed as having intussusception and was admitted to our hospital to treat both the pulmonary tuberculosis and the intussusception. On laboratory examination, the white blood cell count was elevated (15.4 × 103/mm3), the serum C-reactive protein (CRP) level was increased (5.43 mg/dl), and the erythrocyte sedimentation rate was increased (70 mm/h). Macroscopically, it could be seen that the terminal ileum gained entry to the ascending colon.
